questions.question: In a psalm about the nations rebelling, the kings and rulers of the earth take their stand against whom?

answers.text: The LORD and His Anointed One
Moses and the elders of Israel
Elijah and the prophets of God

questions.question: When the kings of the earth plot against the LORD, what does the One enthroned in heaven do?
When the kings of the earth plot against the LORD, what does the LORD announce He has already done?

answers.text: Sent a flood over the earth

questions.question: A psalm warns the rebellious kings of the earth, then ends by calling which people blessed?

answers.text: All who take refuge in Him
All who rule over the earth
